title: Set 241

sentences.ko: 다들 애 생각 있냐고 자꾸 물어봐서, 그만 좀 묻게 하려고 결국 언젠가는 낳겠지 하고 말했거든. 근데 지금 우리 엄마가 내년에 생긴다고 사람들한테 말하고 다녀.
sentences.text: Everybody kept asking if we're thinking about kids, so I finally said maybe someday just to make them stop. But now my mom's telling people it's happening next year.

alts.text: People wouldn't stop asking about kids, so I finally said maybe someday just so they'd quit. Now my mom's going around telling everyone it's happening next year.

Everyone continually asked whether we were considering having children, so I eventually said perhaps someday simply so that they would stop. However, my mother is now telling people that it will happen next year.

sentences.note: **just to make them stop** 는 그만하게 하려고 그냥 해 본 말이라는 느낌이에요. casual 의 **going around telling everyone** 은 여기저기 말하고 다닌다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 유모차는 진짜 좋은데, 솔직히 말하면 바퀴 하나가 끽끽거리고 컵홀더가 똑 부러져 나갔어요. 그래서 60달러만 받는 거예요. 그게 별로 상관없으시면 가져가세요.
sentences.text: It's a great stroller, but I'll be honest, one of the wheels squeaks and the cup holder snapped off, so that's why I'm only asking sixty bucks. If that's not a big deal for you, it's yours.

alts.text: Great stroller, but gotta be honest, one wheel squeaks and the cup holder snapped off, so that's why it's only sixty bucks. If you're cool with that, it's yours.
It is an excellent stroller, but to be honest, one of the wheels squeaks and the cup holder has broken off, which is why I am asking only sixty dollars. If that is not a concern for you, it is yours.

sentences.note: **I'll be honest** 는 솔직히 말씀드리면 하고 단점을 꺼낼 때 써요. **it's yours** 는 물건을 팔거나 줄 때 가져가세요라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 계속 회사 그만둘까 생각하는데, 말하려고 할 때마다 상사가 금요일에 쉬라고 하는 식으로 잘해 줘서 미안해지더라. 근데 그게 남아 있을 이유는 아니잖아, 그치?
sentences.text: I keep thinking about quitting, but every time I'm about to say something, my boss does something nice, like gives me Friday off, and then I feel guilty. I mean, that's not really a reason to stay, right?

alts.text: Quitting's always on my mind, but every time I'm about to say something, my boss does something nice, like giving me Friday off, and then I feel bad. That's not really a reason to stay though, right?

I continue to consider resigning, but whenever I am about to raise the matter, my manager does something kind, such as giving me Friday off, and I then feel guilty. That is not truly a reason to remain, is it?

sentences.note: **I'm about to** 는 막 ~하려던 참이라는 뜻이에요. **I mean** 은 말을 고쳐 잡거나 덧붙일 때 쓰는 말버릇이에요.

sentences.ko: 날씨가 맑을 거라고 해서 소풍을 계획했는데, 공원에 도착하자마자 비가 쏟아지기 시작했어. 그래서 그냥 차 안에서 샌드위치를 먹었는데, 솔직히 좀 재밌었어.
sentences.text: It was supposed to be sunny, so we planned a picnic, but it started pouring the second we got to the park. So we just ate our sandwiches in the car, and honestly, it was kind of fun.

alts.text: They said it'd be sunny, so we planned a picnic, but it started pouring the minute we hit the park. So we ate our sandwiches in the car, and honestly, it was kinda fun.

The forecast called for sunshine, so we planned a picnic, but it began to rain heavily the moment we arrived at the park. We therefore ate our sandwiches in the car, and to be honest, it was rather enjoyable.

sentences.note: **the second we got to** 는 ~하자마자라는 뜻이에요. **pouring** 은 비가 억수같이 쏟아진다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 누가 나가길 기다리면서 커피 들고 그 카페 안을 한 10분은 돌아다녔는데, 겨우 자리가 하나 났더니 노트북 든 어떤 남자가 먼저 앉아 버렸어. 그래서 그냥 창가에 서서 마셨어.
sentences.text: I walked around that cafe with my coffee for like ten minutes waiting for somebody to leave, and when a table finally opened up, some guy with a laptop got there first. So I just drank it standing by the window.

alts.text: Spent like ten minutes wandering around that cafe with my coffee, waiting for someone to leave, and when a table finally opened up, some laptop guy grabbed it first. So I just drank it standing by the window.

I walked around the cafe with my coffee for approximately ten minutes, waiting for someone to leave, and when a table finally became available, a man with a laptop reached it first. I therefore drank it standing by the window.

sentences.note: 자리가 **opened up** 하면 자리가 났다는 뜻이에요. **got there first** 는 누가 먼저 차지했다는 말이고, casual 의 **grabbed it first** 도 같은 뜻이에요.

reviewed: 1번 한국어 '그만 좀 물어보라고 언젠가는 낳겠지 하고 결국 말해 버렸어'가 어순이 꼬여 있어서, just to make them stop의 뜻(그만 묻게 하려고)이 살게 자연스럽게 고쳤습니다.
5번 note의 **a table opened up**이 문장에 그대로 나오지 않아(실제로는 a table finally opened up) 문장에 있는 **opened up**으로 바꿨습니다.
5번 formal의 a gentleman은 뜻에 없는 정중한 느낌을 더해서 a man으로 바꿨습니다.
